published.citation: Demory et al. 2012, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table): 2360 +/- 300 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...751L..28D/abstract

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 4.5 µm (Spitzer Space Telescope satellite Infrared Array Camera (IRAC)) and nobody has imaged it, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: 1 measured of 3 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
temperature.facility: Spitzer Space Telescope satellite Infrared Array Camera (IRAC)
